description.zh:
是否开启自动备份。

- **true**：开启
- **false**：不开启
description.en:
Enable automatic backup. Valid values:

- **true**: Enable

- **false**: Disable

description.zh:
备份网关ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为**agent**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The backup gateway ID. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpointInstanceType** is **agent**.

description.zh:
增量时间间隔，以秒（s）为单位。
> 仅支持物理备份。
description.en:
The incremental interval in seconds (s).

> Only physical backup is supported.

description.zh: 备份对象，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The backup objects. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

description.zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
- **Monday**：周一
- **Tuesday**：周二
- **Wednesday**：周三
- **Thursday**：周四
- **Friday**：周五
- **Saturday**：周六
- **Sunday**：周日
description.en:
The full backup period. Valid values:

- **Monday**: Monday

- **Tuesday**: Tuesday

- **Wednesday**: Wednesday

- **Thursday**: Thursday

- **Friday**: Friday

- **Saturday**: Saturday

- **Sunday**: Sunday

description.zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the backup plan. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query the backup plan ID.

description.zh: 自定义备份计划名称，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The custom backup plan name. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

description.zh:
网络带宽限制， 单位为KB/s ，最大允许10GB。
> 仅对MySQL物理备份生效。
description.en:
The network bandwidth throttling in KB/s. The maximum value is 10 GB.

> This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backup.

description.zh: 备份数据保留时间，取值：0 ~ 1825，默认为730天。
description.en: The retention period for backup data. Valid values: 0 to 1825. Default value: 730 days.

description.zh:
磁盘IO限制 ， 单位为KB/s。
> 仅对MySQL物理备份生效。
description.en:
The disk I/O limit in KB/s.

> This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backup.

description.zh: 全量备份开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The full backup start time in *HH:mm*Z (UTC) format. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

description.zh:
内置存储类型：
- 空（默认）：备份数据存储在用户OSS上。
- system ：备份数据存储在DBS的内置OSS上。
description.en:
The built-in storage type:

- Empty (default): Backup data is stored on your OSS.

- system: Backup data is stored on the built-in OSS of DBS.

description.zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
- **simple**：周期备份，和BackupPeriod、BackupStartTime配合使用。
- **manual**：手动备份。

> 默认为**simple**。
description.en:
The full backup period. Valid values:

- **simple**: Periodic backup. Use this value with BackupPeriod and BackupStartTime.

- **manual**: Manual backup.

> Default value: **simple**.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value, which must be unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

description.zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的UID，可通过调用[DescribeRestoreTaskList](~~2869838~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The UID for cross-Alibaba Cloud account backup. You can call [DescribeRestoreTaskList](~~2869838~~) to query this value.

description.zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称，可通过调用[DescribeRestoreTaskList](~~2869838~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The RAM role name for cross-Alibaba Cloud account backup. You can call [DescribeRestoreTaskList](~~2869838~~) to query this value.

description.zh: 转为归档冷备存储时间，默认为365天。
description.en: The period after which data is converted to archive cold storage. Default value: 365 days.

description.zh: 转为低频访问存储时间，默认为180天。
description.en: The period after which data is converted to Infrequent Access storage. Default value: 180 days.

description.zh:
是否开启增量日志备份，取值：
- **true**：开启
- **false**：关闭
description.en:
Enable incremental log backup. Valid values:

- **true**: Enable

- **false**: Disable

description.zh:
OSS Bucket名称。

> 系统默认自动生成新的名称。
description.en:
The OSS bucket name.

> The system automatically generates a new name by default.

description.zh: 资源组ID。
description.en: The resource group ID.

description.zh:
数据库名称，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> 数据库类型为**PostgreSQL**、**MongoDB**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database name. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

> This parameter is required when the database type is **PostgreSQL** or **MongoDB**.

description.zh:
数据库连接地址，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为**express**、**agent**、**other**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database endpoint. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpointInstanceType** is **express**, **agent**, or **other**.

description.zh:
数据库实例ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**RDS**、**ECS**、**DDS**、**Express**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database instance ID. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is **RDS**, **ECS**, **DDS**, or **Express**.

description.zh:
数据库所在位置，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。取值如下：

- **RDS**
- **ECS**
- **Express**：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
- **Agent**：通过备份网关接入的数据库
- **DDS**：云MongoDB
- **Other**：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
description.en:
The location of the database. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value. Valid values:

- **RDS**

- **ECS**

- **Express**: A database connected through a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Gateway.

- **Agent**: A database connected through a backup gateway.

- **DDS**: Cloud MongoDB.

- **Other**: A database directly connected through IP:Port.

description.zh:
Oracle SID名称。

> 数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The Oracle SID name.

> This parameter is required when the database type is Oracle.

description.zh:
密码。

> 数据库类型为**Redis**，或者数据库所在位置为**agent**且数据库类型为**SQL Server**时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
description.en:
The password.

> This parameter is optional when the database type is **Redis**, or when the database location is **agent** and the database type is **SQL Server**. It is required in other scenarios.

description.zh:
数据库端口，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**express**、**agent**、**other**、**ECS**时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database port. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is **express**, **agent**, **other**, or **ECS**.

description.zh:
数据库地域，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The region of the database. You can call [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpointInstanceType** is RDS, ECS, DDS, Express, or Agent.

description.zh:
数据库账号。

> 数据库类型为**Redis**，或者数据库所在位置为**agent**且数据库类型为**SQL Server**时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
description.en:
The database account.

> This parameter is optional when the database type is **Redis**, or when the database location is **agent** and the database type is **SQL Server**. It is required in other scenarios.
